assignment_rules: A role ID and display name are not an agent_run_id.
Author, Reviewer, Tester, and Integration Owner must be distinct agent runs for every implementation package.
Use Q0 for independent testing and R0 for integration/release when their real assigned agent runs have the required capabilities.
For critical work, apply the cross-vendor preference and specialist review rules in the Decision Register.
